description: Skelet AF-05e Lens REST/MCP/UI parity with durable jobs: MCP lens tools, lens operator UI, migration 013 purge fix, parity and recovery evidence

compatibility.instructions: Does adding 7 MCP tools (lens_create_job, lens_poll_job, lens_get_job, lens_cancel_job, lens_retry_job, lens_resume_job, lens_read_artifact) plus the /lens UI page and migration 013 break the frozen Build Kit v1 manifest contract, the skelet.agent.v1 envelope, existing MCP/REST callers, or the 12-migration ledger? The MCP tools delegate to the same lens-jobs route layer as REST (envelopes identical by construction); tool count grows 6 to 13 with additive schemas only; migration 013 only relaxes two CHECKs for purged rows while live-row guarantees stay. Do existing callers keep working?

correctness.instructions: Are the MCP branches factually correct: identity resolution accepts kitId or skelet://lens URI (both must agree), malformed identifiers answer opaque FORBIDDEN_OR_NOT_FOUND exactly like REST, failures rethrow the identical canonical code with the INVALID_INPUT safe message preserved, read_artifact returns the parsed canonical document plus the same sha256 REST serves? Is the UI factually wired to the real REST routes (create/poll/inspect/cancel/retry/resume/artifacts) with bearer auth, watch-until-terminal with 60s timeout, blob download with X-Content-Sha256, and no mock data? Does migration 013 fix the real retention bug where expiring completed/partial runs always violated the CHECKs?

evidence.instructions: Is the test evidence sufficient: 8 MCP parity tests (advertise, create/replay, REST-MCP convergence with deep-equal poll envelopes, lifecycle mirror, byte-identical artifact digest match, 8 failure cases code-identical, quota, no-model), 2 recovery tests (lease-expiry resume through the route layer with a real time boundary, file-backed close/reopen persistence), 4 UI contract tests, updated 6-to-13 tool-count assertions in 3 files, migration 013 purge regression test, plus full suites (web 72, db 102, lens 186, python 170) green with typecheck/lint/build clean?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism: content-derived kit IDs, idempotent replay, deterministic cancel/retry/resume, lease-expiry preemption shared with the store layer, file-backed persistence across close/reopen, UI watch bounded by timeout with cleanup? Any retry path that double-charges quota or resurrects terminal runs?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond AF-05e parity: new capture, traversal, billing, embeddings, paid services, donor imports, or unrelated refactors? Is the change limited to mcp.ts lens tools, the /lens page, 3 new test files, 3 tool-count assertion updates, migration 013 plus ledger updates, and review evidence?

security.instructions: Do the new surfaces preserve server-side authorization (membership-resolved actorId, unknown and denied answer alike, no oracle), tenant isolation, deterministic quota enforcement, allowlisted artifact names only, withheld files never served, purged outputs 404, bearer tokens never logged, INVALID_INPUT messages bounded safe strings, no secrets or remote code, no mandatory paid provider?

state.change: AF-05e parity: 7 MCP lens tools sharing the REST lens-jobs route layer, /lens operator UI over the real REST contracts, migration 013 terminal-payload purge fix, REST/MCP parity plus lease-expiry recovery plus close/reopen persistence tests, no-model proof.
